etsy.title: Hat Trick Sticker, Funny Hockey Laptop Decal, Three Top Hats Pun, Hockey Player Gift, Team Gift Idea
etsy.description:
A hat trick sticker that takes the term literally: three top hats, three goals, hats optional.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, planner, or the inside of a locker. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
etsy.category: Paper & Party Supplies > Paper > Stickers, Labels & Tags > Stickers

competitorNotes: Single hockey stickers appear at about $3 to $6, and many competitors advertise waterproof vinyl for bottles and cars, which this indoor sticker cannot match.
Hockey mom designs were the most common sticker results seen.

research.notes: One competing "HAT TRICK" sticker shows a rabbit and a magician's hat at $5, so the idea exists but ours uses a different image and joke. Amazon was not searched. Evidence is from search results only, with no sales data.
